tldr: Morning batch, Aug 26 — OpenAI's first custom inference chip Jalapeño posts industry-leading results (SemiAnalysis says it beats Nvidia's Blackwell and even Rubin on throughput and energy efficiency) with production deployment by year-end, backed by CFO Sarah Friar's 'full stack' essay; OpenAI also ships an Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work/Codex and a $100 Business Premium seat for small teams. Open-weight week continues: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next drops tonight as a Qwen4 architecture preview (multimodal MoE, 125B + 51B n-gram params, ~82GB at 4-bit) and IBM releases Granite 4.2 — its first reasoning-focused family (3B/8B/30B, Apache 2.0, 512K context). Google counters with Gemini Enterprise for Legal, using MCP connectors into iManage/DocuSign/Everlaw. On Hermes: the MCP Connectors Catalog grows by 44 one-click connections, Teknium endorses the auxiliary /review model workflow, and Nous Portal runs a week-long 50% Grok 4.6 promo.

articles.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Beats Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin on Inference
articles.summary: OpenAI's first custom inference chip beats Nvidia Blackwell/Rubin on throughput and energy efficiency (SemiAnalysis); production deployment by year-end, Gen 2/3 roadmap in progress.

articles.title: OpenAI CFO: The Full Stack Behind Abundant Intelligence
articles.summary: Sarah Friar explains how chips, compute, models and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.

articles.title: Admin Plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
articles.summary: Analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests across ChatGPT Work and Codex.

articles.title: ChatGPT Business Premium Seats: $100/Seat for Small Teams
articles.summary: New $100 Premium seat targets small businesses and startups with enterprise-grade tools and a plan that scales with team ambition.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Drops Tonight — Qwen4 Architecture Preview
articles.summary: Alibaba open-weights the next-gen architecture: multimodal MoE, 125B main + 51B n-gram lookup params, 6B active per token, ~82GB at 4-bit.

articles.title: Google Launches Gemini Enterprise for Legal
articles.summary: Legal AI with MCP connectors into iManage, DocuSign, Everlaw and Harvey; Deloitte resells pre-built contract agents. MCP is now Google's enterprise play.

articles.title: IBM Releases Granite 4.2 — First Reasoning-Focused Open-Weight Family
articles.summary: 3B/8B/30B models, Apache 2.0, ~15T tokens, 512K context, staged RL through SWE-agent and terminal use; FP8/FP4/GGUF quants included.

articles.title: Apple M6 and M5 Ultra: Mac Studio Up to 512GB Unified Memory
articles.summary: New Mac Studio targets local AI compute: 512GB unified memory, M5 Ultra at 1.2TB/s bandwidth — fits an 80GB+ Qwen-class model locally.

articles.title: Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC: Extremely Fast and Accurate Transcription
articles.summary: IBM's CTC-based speech model ships with very fast, accurate transcription — a strong low-latency option for local speech-to-text.

articles.title: Hermes Agent MCP Connectors Catalog Expands by 44 One-Click Connections
articles.summary: The built-in catalog now offers 44 new app connections with one-click setup in the Hermes Desktop App — lowering the barrier to everyday tool integration.

articles.title: Teknium Endorses Auxiliary /review Model Workflow
articles.summary: Independent review via a second model measurably improved Teknium's Hermes Agent PR quality — the recommended pattern for agent-built work.

articles.title: Grok 4.6 Is 50% Off in Nous Portal for One Week
articles.summary: Week-long promo with SpaceXAI, positioned for long-running agents and ambitious interactive work — and for use with Hermes Agent.

articles.title: Hermes Desktop Adds One-Press Error Sharing
articles.summary: Error popups in the Desktop app now share context with a button press — faster bug-reporting loops for the agent harness.
